component.name: Anchorage
component.summary: Install, update and launch the HarbourMasters game ports from Steam OS game mode

description.p: Certified, artisanal, vibe-coded slop: an AI wrote all of it while a person said "yeah, looks good" and pressed Enter a lot. It downloads programs from the internet, runs them and looks through your SD card for ROMs, and it has never met a real Steam Deck.
Still here? Anchorage is a controller-first launcher for the HarbourMasters PC ports of N64 games:

ul.li: Seven ports as cards with cover art, from Ship of Harkinian to Lighthouse
Install, update and remove each port from its GitHub releases
Finds your own ROMs, with EmuDeck, RetroDECK and the SD card out of the box
Works with a gamepad alone, and every binding can be changed
All four Catppuccin flavours and all 14 accents

description.p: It never downloads ROMs: bring your own.
